answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement is 0.842 and sequence agreement is 0.344, both at or below the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48) and well below fine-tuned (0.900-0.938) and quantized (0.945-0.955). TV is 0.146 and the Token-DiFR gap is 0.469, both at the top of the system-prompted range. Raw-score shift/TV is 3.6, which fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and is below quantized-like values of 2.2-2.3 only in the sense that it is higher, so quantized is ruled out. KL is 0.551, above every documented range, which suggests a large shift but is most consistent with the largest-change category. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, since its raw-score ratio can reach 10.8 and its KL range is also broad, but its top-1 agreement and TV are too low or too high to match.
